entries.query: Why does DISCOVER hand the model a goal instead of a fixed Stage 0/1/2 worker dispatch, and what binds output quality if there's no prescribed pipeline?
entries.notes: Probes the goal-given posture section directly, using this reference's own vocabulary (Stage 0/1/2, goal-given posture) rather than the adjacent principles reference, which states the same idea in more general design terms.

entries.query: Which CI check keeps plugin.json, marketplace.json, and the README version badge from drifting out of agreement with each other?
entries.notes: Names the doctrine.sh version-parity check precisely — a held-out generalization check for a query pattern ("which CI check enforces X") the train set exercises on a different reference (apply's REVIEW.md gate).

entries.query: Why does the routing test run each question three separate times instead of just once?
entries.notes: Targets the three-runs-per-query rationale (flicker detection under non-deterministic routing) using plain "test"/"question" vocabulary instead of "eval harness"/"entry."

entries.query: What's the actual difference between the command that lets me look at proposed changes and the one that makes them permanent?
entries.notes: Plain-terms review-vs-apply distinction, without naming either command — a held-out phrasing of the same workflows territory the train set probes from the apply-gate-internals angle.

entries.query: Our main codebase is really one giant repo with a bunch of unrelated projects mixed together — will that confuse the tool about what actually changed?
entries.notes: Plain-language framing of the one-repo-equals-one-unit problem the monorepo adapter exists to solve, held out to check generalization beyond the train set's slice-mechanics phrasing of the same reference.

entries.query: What do I need to do to get my first working setup running?
entries.notes: Targets the three-install-levels/workflow-lifecycle quickstart pointer rather than the full per-command workflows reference, which is the deeper follow-up, not the first stop.
